name: Mimi motion strength range +50% review
limits: Review-only control range: dynamic strength 0–150; prior candidate maximum was 100. The existing shared strength multiplier uses value/100, so 150 means 1.5x the 100 setting.
Initial review/defaults value is 120 so the stronger sway is immediately visible; setting 100 remains available for direct comparison.
All v81 motion settings are inherited, including bilateral thigh/knee response with ankles and soles fixed. This does not alter any production default or other character.
